items.title: Alvin Alcorn Interview, 1976-01-25
items.q: The interviewee discusses 'Papa Joe' in the context of another musician ('him', likely Louis Armstrong or similar) breaking with him. The interviewee states 'Joe was the one that sent for him to come up there', describing a relationship between Joe and the third party, not explicitly between Joe and

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. And break with Papa Joe? And break with Papa Joe?

Oh, yeah, because he was doing plenty of things, you know. Well, Joe was the one that sent for him to come up there. Yeah. And Joe and him, uh, he was going on his own, because he, doing plenty of recording. He was like, like, some guys that were recording with the Hot Five, Johnny Dodds, and all of them. But that was an organized group. They'd get together for that, uh, just recording. That's really the only time they played was when they recorded, right?
